items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: Oh, Gold Fingers, yeah. Yeah ten piano players, we go to Japan every other year

ctx.x: Did I see you had a part in this “Hundred Fingers?”
Oh, Gold Fingers, yeah. Yeah ten piano players, we go to Japan every other year and they take what they call, what I heard, one token woman each time.
